name: Kneeling Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Kneel with your hands under your chest, just inside shoulder width.
Shift forward until your head, hips and knees line up, then brace your abdomen.
Bend your elbows close to your sides to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your arms back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked alongside your ribs rather than letting them flare out wide.
Avoid piking your hips back over your knees as you push up.
